body.title: Kind-aware tracker persistence + issueRef write-back
body.summary: mutateEpicTrackerMeta + sync.ts persist to definitionHeadJsonPath (readable-head rule); issueRef write-back on first publication
acceptanceChecks: integration: finalize push+sync on ISSUE-only fixture writes meta.tracker onto ISSUE json, binds EPIC/STORY-s1 heads, readdir zero DEF files; corrupt-DEF/valid-ISSUE finalize lands on ISSUE json; ISSUE push writes meta.tracker.issueRef back on first publication; sync storiesOf uses impliedIssueStories for ISSUE heads

tests.name: src/workflow/orchestrator.ts mutateEpicTrackerMeta + finalizeTracker — finalize push+sync on ISSUE-only seed repo: ISSUE meta.tracker written, EPIC/STORY-s1 heads bound, readdir zero DEF-*.json; corrupt-DEF/valid-ISSUE finalize lands on ISSUE json; issueRef write-back on first publication
src/workflow/tracker/sync.ts — storiesOf uses impliedIssueStories for ISSUE heads; patchTrackerMeta writes onto the resolved head; closeBugfixTrackerIssue closes via readRecordedRef (stubbed)
first publication sequence — approve ISSUE with tracking disabled, enable, push: exactly 1 create, issueRef written back + heads bound; write-back failure -> retry adopts with 0 creates
